title: Crypto Brief — 15 Nov 2026
intro: Asian trading opens on a cautious note with risk appetite constrained by elevated US Treasury yields and a strengthening dollar index. Cryptocurrencies are stabilizing following sharp weekly losses while traditional markets digest political and corporate developments.

sections.heading: ETH/BTC 0.02782
sections.content:
4/10 alts beating BTC over 1W
1W best Zcash -7.8% · worst Solana -16.4%

sections.heading: Crypto theme
sections.content: Macro headwindscontinue to dictate crypto flows as the US 10Y yield climbs 5.1bp to 5.154 percent and the DXY edges up to 103.41. Risk assets are consolidating as market participants weigh tightening financial conditions against the backdrop of recent tech sector volatility.

sections.heading: Bitcoin & Ether
sections.content: Bitcoin trades at 63,823, down 0.48 percent today and 13.7 percent over the week, maintaining a fragile structure near multi-week lows. Ethereum holds at 1,775.83, registering a 0.38 percent daily gain and an ETH/BTC ratio of 0.02782.

sections.heading: Altcoins
sections.content: Alternative assets display mild intraday relief but remain under heavy weekly pressure, with only 4 out of 10 tracked alts beating Bitcoin over the past seven days. Zcash leads weekly performance down 7.8 percent at 890.97, while Solana lags as the worst weekly performer down 16.4 percent at 69.66.

sections.heading: Potential scenarios
sections.content:
- *▲ Bullish · Bitcoin — above 64,460 opens 67,000 · invalid below 62,500*
A sustained move above minor intraday resistance could prompt short-term relief buying toward the mid-60k region.
- *▼ Bearish · Solana — below 68.27 opens 65.50 · invalid above 71.00*
Persistent relative weakness and heavy weekly losses leave the asset vulnerable to renewed selling pressure toward key psychological support.
- *▲ Bullish · Ethereum — above 1,793.00 opens 1,860.00 · invalid below 1,740.00*

sections.heading: Key risks
sections.content:
- Further upside in US Treasury yields tightening broader financial conditions.
- Persistent macro pressure from strengthening dollar index constraining altcoin recovery.
